note: Authored, source-verified per-year edition facts for the recurring programmes registry. Each row records what an official page LITERALLY published, with the URL and the date it was checked. Absence of a row is meaningful: it means no dated edition has been confirmed, and the seeded default 'expected' row stands. status 'open' is NOT permitted in this file - the seed script rejects it - because only a deliberate human action may mark an edition open (PROGRAMMES-REGISTRY-HANDOFF.md sec 6). Never infer a date; if an official page does not publish one, leave it out.
